senses.zh_definition: 尚未核实的词形；可能是外来专名。日剧语境中的 Nobuta 可指《野猪大改造》角色小谷信子的绰号，但不能据此认定输入词的具体所指。
senses.en_definition: An unverified form, possibly a foreign proper name; in the Japanese television drama Nobuta wo Produce, Nobuta is Nobuko Kotani's nickname.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk yang belum disahkan sebagai kata bahasa Melayu; mungkin nama khas asing. Dalam konteks drama Jepun Nobuta wo Produce, Nobuta ialah nama panggilan watak Nobuko Kotani.
senses.nuances: noun 仅为潜在专名用法的暂定分类。输入包没有 DBP 释义，不能标为已确认的官方马来语词条。以下搭配与例句均为讨论字符串的教学示例，不是已证实的高频词汇搭配。日剧专名用法见[日本电视台介绍](https://www.ntv.co.jp/topics/articles/19zk6wgygyaua3thv4.html)。

etymology.historical_story: The packet does not establish a Malay origin for this form. One documented cultural use comes from Japanese television: NTV identifies Nobuta as the nickname of Nobuko Kotani in Nobuta wo Produce. That reference explains one possible encounter with the spelling, but it does not identify the packet's source or establish a Malay borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 nobuta 当作姓名标签整块记；找到原句后再确定读音与所指，不凭 buta 猜词义。
